compileNote: All records were compiled on 2026-07-26 from the most recent published editions of the datasets below, as known to the compiling model. The build environment's network policy blocked live retrieval (including the Overpass API), so values are registry-consistent approximations rounded to sensible precision. Every record must be re-verified against the live dataset before client use. Fields that could not be confirmed are null, never invented.

faa_npias.name: National Plan of Integrated Airport Systems (NPIAS) 2025-2029

ntd_upt.name: National Transit Database, 2023 Annual Database, Unlinked Passenger Trips

ipeds.name: IPEDS Institutional Characteristics and Fall Enrollment, 2023

cms_pos.name: Provider of Services File, government-owned hospitals, Q4 2023
cms_pos.publisher: Centers for Medicare and Medicaid Services

census_aspep.name: Annual Survey of Public Employment and Payroll, 2023

epa_sdwis.name: Safe Drinking Water Information System, large public water systems

gsa_iolp.name: Inventory of Owned and Leased Properties (IOLP)
gsa_iolp.fields: building identity, coordinates, gross square feet

osm.name: OpenStreetMap via Overpass API
osm.fields: building attributes: floors, height, built year, construction, roof
osm.note: Live Overpass retrieval was blocked by the build environment's network policy. Building attributes are null unless the value is widely documented and consistent with OSM tags, in which case the record's provenance note says so explicitly. Null building attributes are surfaced in the Verification Queue as no-record items by design.

us_atlas.name: US Atlas TopoJSON, states-albers-10m (Census Bureau cartographic boundary files, 1:10M, pre-projected d3 geoAlbersUsa)
us_atlas.publisher: U.S. Census Bureau via the us-atlas project
us_atlas.fields: state and nation boundary geometry and projected entity map points
us_atlas.note: Retrieved live from the us-atlas npm package at build time. This is the one dataset in this compile that was fetched, not reconstructed.

bea_gdp.name: SAGDP1 State Annual Gross Domestic Product, 2024
bea_gdp.fields: state nominal GDP used for the market cartogram and premium pool
